title: Nakajima Satoru Kanshuu - Super F-1 Hero
aliases: Nakajima Satoru Kanshuu: Super F-1 Hero
description: First-person Formula One racing game published by Varie in 1992. The game features Japanese F1 racer Satoru Nakajima and was only released in Japan.
